Composio Product Ops · Take-Home Case Study

What does it take to build for 100 apps?

I built an agent pipeline that researched 2 SaaS apps across 10 categories for Composio toolkit buildability, then tried to prove itself wrong. Using @composio/core catalog checks, an automated HTTP + keyword grounding verifier with bounded repair loops, and a stratified 20-app human audit, field-level accuracy rose from N/A (Pass 1) to N/A (Pass 2) to N/A (Final).

Evidence Rule
Unknown beats a guess.

Every row carries an HTTP-checked docs URL and strict Zod enum. Unverified fields stay unknown.

Headline Insights (2-Minute Executive Summary)

  • OAUTH2 is the dominant auth pattern (1/2 apps, 50%), while CRM and Sales is the most self-serve category.
  • 2 of 2 apps are immediate net-new toolkit wins (self-serve credentials, public API docs, not yet in Composio's catalog; 0 already covered).
  • Access gating clusters heaviest in CRM and Sales.
  • 2 apps already ship an official MCP server (Salesforce, Pipedrive).

02 / The Agent & Human-in-the-Loop

Three passes. One evidence trail.

Crash-safe JSONL checkpoints, deterministic URL + keyword grounding, and human audit recycled back into data.

@COMPOSIO/CORE + ZOD + VITEST
1

Pass 1 · Research Agent

Batched concurrency-limited fetcher (p-limit) scrapes official docs, queries Composio's toolkit catalog, and extracts strict Zod JSON with per-app JSONL checkpoints.

DISCOVER · EXTRACT · CHECKPOINT
2

Pass 2 · Verifier + Fixer

Re-fetches every evidence URL across all 100 apps (HTTP 200 + field keyword grounding). Failures enter a bounded repair loop (max 2 rounds); changes logged in diff-log.json.

HTTP 200 · GROUND · BOUNDED FIX
3

Pass 3 · Human Audit

Humans audited a deterministic 20-app stratified sample (2/category), resolved JS-rendered portals and borderline partner gates, and recycled fixes back into Pass 2.

20-APP SAMPLE · FIX · RE-VERIFY

Named Misses & Honest Limitations

Zero unresolved misses in the stratified audit sample (Pass 2 automated verifier caught 0 broken/blocked URLs and logged 0 automated field repairs).

Deliberate disclosures: Self-serve vs paid judgments rely on public docs/pricing text rather than creating 100 paid accounts; JS-rendered doc shells (e.g., Stoplight/Redoc) that could not be text-grounded are honestly marked lower confidence or manually verified in Pass 3.
